generation_prompt:
Write 4 player characters for a Fate game set in The Sallowmere.

Setting:
The Sallowmere is a lowland of rivers, reed and ruined temples that has been drowning for eleven years. The rain has not stopped in all that time, and the floodwaters climb a finger's width each week. Hollowmoot, a crowded stilt-town, is the last real settlement; the Ashwater Causeway is its only dry road north, and Gullet Ford the only crossing south. A blight called the hive spreads through wounds and bad water, making its victims hive-touched: feral, pain-blind, and drawn to a swarm-song that seems to come from the flooded belltower of Saint Orrin's Drowned Temple. The shrunken Order of the Dry Saint guards what lore survives, while a renegade Drowned Priest preaches that the hive is holy. The Causeway Wardens burn infected houses and tax every crossing, the Blackwater Cartel smuggles food and people through hidden cellars, and the Stiltfolk Clans watch it all from the reeds. Play it grounded: cold hands, wet rope, hard choices about who gets the last dry bed.

Named places and groups you may tie characters to: Gullet Ford, Hollowmoot, Order of the Dry Saint, Saint Orrin's Drowned Temple, The Ashwater Causeway, The Blackwater Cartel, The Causeway Wardens, The Stiltfolk Clans, The Wick Lane Cellars.

Each character needs:
- binder: exactly 4 theme cards in this order: 2 ROOTS (an origin, a person, a place or a comfort), then 2 REACH (an oath, a burden, a power or a goal). Each card: a title, exactly 3 power tags (2-5 words each, each names one thing the character can do, has or is) and 1 weakness tag that can plausibly cause trouble in a scene. At least one ROOTS power tag must name a specific named person, group or place.
- story_cards: exactly 2: one NPC drawn from a ROOTS tag, one THREAD (an open question) drawn from a REACH tag, same tag format.
- skills (Fate Core skill names only: Athletics, Burglary, Contacts, Crafts, Deceive, Drive, Empathy, Fight, Investigate, Lore, Notice, Physique, Provoke, Rapport, Resources, Shoot, Stealth, Will): one great, two good, three fair, four average, all different.
- approaches (Careful, Clever, Flashy, Forceful, Quick, Sneaky): one +3, two +2, two +1, one +0.
- fae: the SAME character in Fate Accelerated form: a high concept, a trouble that mirrors one card weakness, and 3 aspects that compress the four cards (keep the same named people and places).

Use these seeds, one per character, in order:
[
 {
  "name": "Fallow",
  "concept": "Innkeeper's heir carrying a debt-ledger",
  "origin": "an orphan of the first hive outbreak",
  "bond": "a tavern that keeps your room",
  "drive": "map the safe roads before they vanish",
  "flaw": "family feud with a stilt clan"
 },
 {
  "name": "Caddock",
  "concept": "Hedge-lawyer who settles debt feuds",
  "origin": "the only survivor of a sunken barge",
  "bond": "a cartel lieutenant who favours you",
  "drive": "never let another house burn",
  "flaw": "proud beyond reason"
 },
 {
  "name": "Garrick",
  "concept": "Ratcatcher of the flooded cellars",
  "origin": "grew up on the Causeway's toll gate",
  "bond": "a ford where you nearly drowned",
  "drive": "earn back a clan's trust",
  "flaw": "hiding hive marks"
 },
 {
  "name": "Corvin",
  "concept": "Eel-fisher turned reluctant sellsword",
  "origin": "born in a quarantine house",
  "bond": "a Warden who looked the other way for you",
  "drive": "keep forged papers from being traced",
  "flaw": "trusts no outsider"
 }
]

Make the four characters distinct in role, and give each at least one tie to another character's people or places only if it arises naturally.
